import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
gi,go=G['Demo pair 1 input'],G['Demo pair 1 output']
gi2,go2=G['Demo pair 2 input'],G['Demo pair 2 output']
gt=G['Test input']

def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
from collections import Counter
def solve(g, mode):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bc=max((c for c,v in cnt.items() if c!=0), key=lambda c: cnt[c])
    P={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==bc}
    rs=[r for r,c in P]; cs=[c for r,c in P]
    B=[[g[r][c] for c in range(min(cs),max(cs)+1)] for r in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1)]
    Bh,Bw=max(rs)-min(rs)+1,max(cs)-min(cs)+1
    dots=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bc and g[r][c]!=0]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    if mode=='center': cr,cc=Bh//2,Bw//2
    elif mode=='tl': cr,cc=0,0
    else: continue
    for dot in dots:
        rr0=dot[0]-cr; cc0=dot[1]-cc
        for i in range(Bh):
            for j in range(Bw):
                x,y=rr0+i,cc0+j
                if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w: out[x][y]=B[i][j]
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    pred=solve(G[k+' input'],'center'); exp=G[k+' output']
    mism=[(a,b) for a,b in zip(pred,exp) if a!=b]
    print(k,'mode=center mismatches:',len(mism),'sample diffs rows:',[m[0] for m in mism][:3])

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
def solve(g, anchor):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bc=max((c for c,v in cnt.items() if c!=0), key=lambda c: cnt[c])
    P={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==bc}
    rs=[r for r,c in P]; cs=[c for r,c in P]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    B=[[g[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    Bh,Bw=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    dots=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bc and g[r][c]!=0]
    cr,cc=Bh//2,Bw//2
    if anchor=='center': dr,dc=-cr,-cc
    elif anchor=='tl': dr,dc=0,0
    else: return None
    for dot in dots:
        rr0=dot[0]+dr; cc0=dot[1]+dc
        for i in range(Bh):
            for j in range(Bw):
                x,y=rr0+i,cc0+j
                if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w: out[x][y]=B[i][j]
    return out
for ank in ['center','tl']:
    print(ank, [solve(G[k+' input'],ank)==G[k+' output'] for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']])
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'],'center')))

def analyze(k):
    gi=G[k+' input']; go=G[k+' output']
    h,w=len(gi),len(gi[0])

def blocks_of(gi):

    cnt=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r)
    bc=max((c for c,v in cnt.items() if c!=0 and v),key=lambda c:v)

    rs=[r for r,c in P]; cs=[c for r,c in P]
    return bc,min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs),[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if gi[r][c]!=bc and gi[r][c]!=0]

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def build(k):
    gi=G[k+' input']; go=G[k+' output']
    h,w=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r)
    bc=max((c for c,v in cnt.items() if c!=0 and v),key=lambda c:v)
    P=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if gi[r][c]==bc]
    rs=[r for r,c in P]; cs=[c for r,c in P]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    B=[[gi[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    Bh,Bw=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
    dots={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if gi[r][c]!=bc and gi[r][c]!=0}
    # brute force absolute anchor TL (not mod)
    scores=[]
    for tr in range(h-Bh+1):
        for tc in range(w-Bw+1):
            mm=0
            for i in range(h):
                for j in range(w):
                    e=B[(i-tr)%Bh][(j-tc)%Bw]
                    if (i,j) not in dots and e!=go[i][j]: mm+=1
            cov=sum(1 for i in range(h) for j in range(w)
                   if (i,j) not in dots and B[(i-tr)%Bh][(j-tc)%Bw]==go[i][j])
            scores.append((mm,-cov,tr,tc))
    best=min(scores)
    print(k,'best abs anchor',(best[2],best[3]),'mmismatch',abs(best[0]),'consistent',True if best[0]==0 else False)
build('Demo pair 1'); build('Demo pair 2'); build('Demo pair 3')

from collections import Counter,deque
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

# Candidate: block = bounding box of the most common non-zero color, solid fill assumed.
# Output = tile(block) anchored at ORIGINAL block TL + at each DOT TL; clips OK. Test thoroughly with clean code.
def solve(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r)
    bc=max((c for c,v in cnt.items() if v>0), key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if gi[r][c]==bc]
    r0,c0,r1,c1=min(p[0] for p in pts),min(p[1] for p in pts),max(p[0] for p in pts),max(p[1] for p in pts)
    B=[[gi[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    bh,bw=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
    # stamps: original TL and each dot TL
    stamps=[(r0,c0)]+[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if gi[r][c]!=0 and gi[r][c]!=bc]
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for tr,tc in stamps:
        for i in range(bh):
            for j in range(bw):
                rr,cc=tr+i,tc+j
                if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W: out[rr][cc]=B[i][j]
    return out,B,(r0,c0,bh,bw)

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    p,B,a=solve(G[k+' input']); go=G[k+' output']
    mis=[(i,j,p[i][j],go[i][j]) for i in range(len(go)) for j in range(len(go[0])) if p[i][j]!=go[i][j]]
    print(k,'mis',len(mis),'anchor',a,'sample',mis[:6])

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def tiled(gi, anchors=None):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    tws=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if gi[r][c]==2]
    r0=min(p[0] for p in tws); c0=min(p[1] for p in tws)
    r1=max(p[0] for p in tws); c1=max(p[1] for p in tws)
    bh,bw=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
    B=[[gi[r0+i][c0+j] for j in range(bw)] for i in range(bh)]
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i in range(H-bh+1):
        for j in range(W-bw+1):
            if anchors is None or (i,j) in anchors:
                for a in range(bh):
                    for b in range(bw):
                        rr,cc=i+a,j+b
                        out[rr][cc]=B[a][b]
    return out

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    o=tiled(G[k+' input']); go=G[k+' output']
    print(k,'match' if o==go else 'no')
# try anchoring only at dots+original
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    gi=G[k+' input']; go=G[k+' output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    tws=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if gi[r][c]==2]
    r0=min(p[0] for p in tws); c0=min(p[1] for p in tws)
    r1=max(p[0] for p in tws); c1=max(p[1] for p in tws)
    bh,bw=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
    dots=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if gi[r][c]!=2 and gi[r][c]!=0]
    ans=tiled(gi,{(r0,c0)}|set(dots))
    go2=G[k+' output']
    mis=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if ans[i][j]!=go2[i][j]]
    print(k,'mis',len(mis), mis[:5])

def load():

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def f(gi, mode='center'):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    tws=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if gi[r][c]==2]
    r0=min(p[0] for p in tws); c0=min(p[1] for p in tws)
    r1=max(p[0] for p in tws); c1=max(p[1] for p in tws)
    bh,bw=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
    B=[[gi[r0+i][c0+j] for j in range(bw)] for i in range(bh)]
    out=[row[:] for row in gi]
    cr,cc=bh//2,bw//2
    # draw tiles in order; noise cells are last drawn so they keep value
    noise=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if gi[r][c]!=2 and gi[r][c]!=0]
    # but noise should appear only as-is; stamps drawn before noise? Test both orders.
    for r,c in noise:
        out[r][c]=gi[r][c]
    for r,c in noise:
        tr,tc=r-cr,c-cc
        for i in range(bh):

                rr,_ctj=tr+i,tc+j
                if 0<=rr<H and 0<=_ctj<W:
                    out[rr][_ctj]=B[i][j]
    return out

for mode in ['center']:

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

# Find solid rectangular 2-regions in each output (noise excluded), print their TLs.
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    go=G[k+' output']; H,W=len(go),len(go[0])
    regs=[]
    seen=set()
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if go[r][c]==2 and (r,c) not in seen:
                # grow rectangle up/left
                rr=r
                while rr>0 and go[rr-1][c]==2: rr-=1
                cc=c
                while cc>0 and go[r][cc-1]==2: cc-=1
                hgt=r-rr+1; wid=c-cc+1
                reg=(rr,cc,hgt,wid)
                seen.add(reg)  # will dedupe below via normalization later
                regs.append(reg)
    regs=sorted(set(regs))
    print('===',k)
    for r,c,h,w in regs:
        # normalize: only keep if can't extend further vertically/horizontally (maximal)
        up = any(go[r-1][c+j]==2 for j in range(c,c+w)) or False
        left = any(go[r+i][c-1]==2 for i in range(r,r+h)) or False
        print(f'  TL({r},{c}) {h}x{w}   up={any(go[r-1][c+j]==2 for j in range(c,c+w))} left={any(go[r+i][c-1]==2 for i in range(r,r+h))}')

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
# Re-examine outputs carefully, comparing against tiled pattern anchored at original block TL with noise preserved.
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    gi=G[k+' input']; go=G[k+' output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    tws=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if gi[r][c]==2]
    r0=min(p[0] for p in tws); c0=min(p[1] for p in tws)
    r1=max(p[0] for p in tws); c1=max(p[1] for p in tws)
    bh,bw=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
    B=[[gi[r0+i][c0+j] for j in range(bw)] for i in range(bh)]
    oP=[[B[(i-r0)%bh][(j-c0)%bw] for j in range(W)] for i in range(H)]
    # check demo2 specifically: is it actually period-5 from TL(5,4)? mismatches found earlier. Let's look at go==2 cells where oP==0.
    print('===',k,'mismatches where oP!=go:')
    mis=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if go[i][j]!=oP[i][j]: mis.append((i,j,go[i][j],oP[i][j]))
    # group by offset from orig TL? Print first 60 and classify
    ok=True
    for i,j,gv,pv in mis:
        if gv==2: ok=False; break
    print('no 2 where tile says 0:',ok)
    # maybe tiles are clipped horizontally/vertically per dot: only the part visible around dot? Look at counts of tiles near dots vs others
    cnt=0
    for i,j,gv,pv in mis:
        if pv==2 and gv==0: cnt+=1
    print('total mismatch',len(mis),'tile-predicted-but-zero:',cnt)
    # count distinct full tiles present: positions where BOTH are all-2 blocks fully inside grid
    full=[]
    for tr in range(H-bh+1):
        for tc in range(W-bw+1):

                full.append((tr,tc))
    print('full 2-block positions (both tiles):',sorted(set(full)))

import os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    gi=G[k+' input']; go=G[k+' output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cs=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if gi[r][c]==2]
    r0=min(p[0] for p in cs); c0=min(p[1] for p in cs)
    r1=max(p[0] for p in cs); c1=max(p[1] for p in cs)
    bh=r1-r0+1; bw=c1-c0+1
    print('===',k,'block TL',(r0,c0),'size',bh,bw)
    # exact 2-sets per output row
    for i in range(H):
        Ps=set(j for j,x in enumerate(go[i]) if x==2)
        pred=set(c0+(j-c0)%bw for j in range(W)) if r0<=i<=r1 else None
        print(i,'twos:',sorted(Ps)[:12],'...' if len(Ps)>12 else '', 'pred_ok' if pred==Ps else 'PHASE_MISMATCH (period-bw tiling)', 'n2=',len(Ps))

def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); keys=['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']

def tile(g,r0,c0,bh,bw,keep_inside_band=True,keep_dot_outside=True):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    B=[[g[r0+i][c0+j] for j in range(bw)] for i in range(bh)]
    out=[[g[r][c] for c in range(W)] for r in range(H)]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            v=B[r%bh][c%bw]
            if g[r][c]!=2 and g[r][c]==2:
                pass
            # tile covers; but respect dots
            if v!=g[r][c]:
                inside=r0<=r<=r0+bh-1 and c0<=c<=c0+bw-1
                if inside and not keep_inside_band: continue
                if g[r][c]!=2 and not keep_dot_outside: continue
